---------- Original Message ---------- 
From: RICHARD KUDRAK <rkudrak21@comcast.net> 
To: afenech@freepress.com 
Cc: cthomas@freepress.com 
Date: August 23, 2019 at 9:40 AM 
Subject: MLB official: Astros were wrong to block writer
I know what you said about this incident. I know the Freep complained about this incident. What I don't know is why Verlander wanted you barred from the Astros clubhouse.
It's now time for you to give your readers the details of Verlander's complaint from your point of view. I really don't like hearing only one side of a dispute.
